## Claim or file

Quote the relevant passage or identify the JSON entry/code location.

## Problem or counterexample

Explain the incorrect assumption, missing path, classification issue or observed behavior.

## Evidence

Link a primary source or provide reproduction steps with synthetic data. Include versions where relevant. Do not include credentials, customer data or confidential materials.

## Proposed correction

Distinguish a factual correction from an alternative mapping or a request for a future experiment.
